name: Easy Slider, Carousel by Trident – Image Slider, Video Slider, Content Slider With Animations
author: Trident Technolabs

sections.description:
Easy slider, Carousel by Trident is a simple yet flexible WordPress plugin that lets you create responsive sliders powered by the popular Swiper.js library.
Add unlimited slides, customize styling, and display your slider anywhere using a shortcode.

Features

  • Add unlimited sliders with unlimited slides
  • Fully responsive & touch-enabled
  • Easy to use shortcode: [easy-slider-advanced id="123"]
  • Image background support
  • Slide content with title, text, button, and custom styles
  • Custom height, colors, text size, and alignment
  • Smooth animation effects
  • Lightweight and fast loading

Upgrade to Easy slider, Carousel by Trident Pro
Unlock more powerful features in the Pro version:

  • Video background support
  • Advanced animations
  • Multiple button positions & alignments
  • Custom slide duration per slide
  • More styling options for button and text
  • Premium support

External services

This plugin connects to tridenttechnolabs.com to verify license keys. When verifying or activating a license the plugin sends the license email, license key, and the site URL (home_url()) to:
https://tridenttechnolabs.com/check_license.php

Purpose: License validation for Easy slider Advanced Pro.
Data sent: email, license_key, site_url.
Service provider: Trident Technolabs — privacy policy / terms: https://tridenttechnolabs.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/trident-slider-advanced directory, or install directly from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in wordpress.
  3. Create a new slider under Easy slider, Carousel > Add New Slider.
  4. Copy the shortcode [easy-slider-carousel id="123"] and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add a slider to my site?

After creating a slider, copy the shortcode [easy-slider-carousel id="123"] and paste it into your page, post, or widget.

Does it work with Gutenberg / Block Editor?

Yes! you can insert the shortcode inside a Shortcode Block.

Is it responsive?

Yes. Easy slider Advanced is fully responsive and touch enabled.

What extra features are in the Pro version?

Video slides, advanced animations, custom duration, multiple alignments, and more design flexibility.
